claims.text: The evaluation includes the edit distance of the generated text compared to its corrected variant, reflecting the effort needed for corrections.
The word error rate (WER) of the generated text is reported as 5.6%, indicating the accuracy of the text generation.
Manual evaluations were conducted to assess the acceptability of the output for production use in a news agency.
The output is evaluated based on its usability for a news channel, focusing on machine-generated content.
